title: Person in pool with a single robotic submersible and lane divider
objects_and_counts: One adult person is visible at the left side of the image, waist-deep and partially submerged; the person's head and upper torso are visible and the person is facing right.

One small torpedo-shaped robotic device or submersible is visible partially submerged and traveling to the right in the lane to the right of the person; the device is centered vertically in the image and partially above the water surface where a small splash is visible.

One swimming lane divider (rope with floats) is visible running horizontally across the top of the image; the rope shows a repeated pattern of blue floats with a short segment of red floats at the right edge.
One dark continuous lane-mark stripe composed of black tiles is visible on the pool floor under the water, running horizontally across the middle of the image and passing beneath the robotic device.
One pair of swim goggles is visible on the person's head.
